cell_type: Micro-dissected morphologically normal human lung alveoli (0.082 mm3) and human lung blood vessels (0.094 mm3) from FFPE-fixed H&E-stained sections from Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF) specimens (n = 3 IPF specimens) were then subject to a qualitative and then quantitative proteomics approach using BayesENproteomics.
disease_state: The specimens used for this study met the criteria for Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF) diagnosis, however, we used distal lung tissue that appeared morphologically normal for the LCM-MS study.
material_type: Herein, we utilize heat extraction, physical disruption, and in column digestion for the analysis of H&E stained FFPE tissues.
sample_source: Micro-dissected morphologically normal human lung alveoli (0.082 mm3) and human lung blood vessels (0.094 mm3) from FFPE-fixed H&E-stained sections from Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF) specimens (n = 3 IPF specimens) were then subject to a qualitative and then quantitative proteomics approach using BayesENproteomics.
